name: Acromioclavicular Joint Injury
definition: Traumatic injury of the acromioclavicular and coracoclavicular ligament complex, commonly from a direct fall onto the shoulder.

investigations.radiographs: AP/Zanca radiographs assess alignment and fracture.

green: Sling briefly for comfort in low-grade injury
amber: Higher-grade injuries require individualized orthopedic assessment; surgery is not automatic.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Amsa-sandhi traumatic phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Traumatic injury of the acromioclavicular and coracoclavicular ligament complex, commonly from a direct fall onto the shoulder.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for severe/progressive neurological deficit, vascular compromise, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
